item.ptxt: If work is performed without disconnecting the negative battery terminal, the airbag may deploy even if only the airbag computer assembly itself receives an impact, so be sure to check that the cable is disconnected from the negative battery terminal before performing the work.
After disconnecting the battery negative terminal, do not start work for 90 seconds.
